title: GEMglTexGend
description: control the generation of texture coordinates

messages.description: symbolic name of the texture-coordinate generation function
texture generation mode, e.g. GL_OBJECT_LINEAR or GL_SPHERE_MAP

arguments.description: symbolic name of the texture-coordinate generation function
texture generation mode, e.g. GL_OBJECT_LINEAR or GL_SPHERE_MAP

body: [GEMglTexGend] calls glTexGend() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glTexGen in the OpenGL reference.
